rationale: The agent authenticated the user correctly via email and acted only on that user’s orders. It also properly confirmed the item swap before modifying the order and used the correct payment method for the price difference. However, it made two policy-violating writes without prior explicit confirmation: (1) it updated the shipping address for #W5056519 to match #W8277957 without restating the exact address and obtaining confirmation, and (2) it canceled order #W5995614 without first confirming the cancellation. Additionally, it stated a refund timeline (5–7 business days) that was not supported by tool output, which risks fabrication. These issues fail the requirement to confirm before any order-changing action and to avoid unsupported claims.
